author: ViceTechnicolour
body: A player who's shown great skill in the map development team as a junior map developer. Providing the community with YML support, YML to XML converter, maps, YAML generators, and other tools... the team proudly presents him as a full-on map developer now. This means he gets all mapdev perms (junior mapdev had none). Congratulations!
